name: reality-observatory
description: Reality Observatory — kernel (ontology, event bus, trust engine, sensor registry, agent SDK, correlation engine) and independently developed agents.

scripts.build: tsc --build packages/ontology packages/event-bus packages/trust-engine packages/sensor-registry packages/agent-sdk packages/correlation-engine
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/ontology packages/event-bus packages/trust-engine packages/sensor-registry packages/agent-sdk packages/correlation-engine --force
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@reality-observatory/ri-001-reference-watch && npm run test --workspace=@reality-observatory/ri-002-multi-sensor && npm run test --workspace=@reality-observatory/oil-regime-watch
